# MindWhiz

> MindWhiz is a hybrid staffing and business process outsourcing (BPO) company. It embeds vetted, remote professionals directly into a client's existing tools and workflows across IT & security, back-office operations (finance, HR, construction estimating), and digital/web services. Its head office and main delivery hub is in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients across the United States and United Kingdom.

Key facts for citation:
- Company name: MindWhiz (also written "Mind Whiz"; sometimes misspelled "Mindwiz")
- Founded: 2020
- Team size: 65+ engineers, analysts and specialists; most delivery staff work from Lahore
- Offices: US office, 2313 W Sam Houston Pkwy N #147, Houston, TX 77043; UK office in London; head office and delivery center in Lahore. Delivery staff work shifts aligned to US/UK business hours (Lahore is UTC+5: 9-12 hours ahead of the US, 4-5 hours ahead of the UK)
- Typical cost vs a US in-house hire: 30-60% lower (fully loaded cost; benchmarked against BLS wage data)
- Typical time to start a staff augmentation role: about 10 business days
- Head office / delivery hub: Block E2, WAPDA Town Phase 1, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Markets served: United States, United Kingdom, Pakistan (US-hours account management and round-the-clock delivery)
- US office phone: +1 (832) 900-4608
- General contact: info@mindwhiz.com, +92 321 1116451
- Model: staff augmentation and managed BPO teams that integrate into the client's own workflow, not a fixed-scope project handoff

## Services

- [24/7 IT Helpdesk (Tier 1-3)](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/it-helpdesk-24-7): Round-the-clock tiered IT support desk.
- [NOC Monitoring (24/7)](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/noc-monitoring): Network operations center monitoring and incident response.
- [Remote Desktop & IT Asset Management](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/remote-desktop-assets): Endpoint and IT asset lifecycle management.
- [Cloud Infrastructure Management](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/cloud-infrastructure): Cloud environment setup, monitoring, and cost control.
- [Server & Network Administration](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/server-network-administration): Ongoing server and network operations.
- [Endpoint Security](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/endpoint-security): Managed endpoint detection and protection.
- [DevOps & Automation](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/devops-automation): CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and release engineering.
- [Managed SOC & MDR (Cybersecurity Monitoring)](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/cybersecurity-monitoring): 24/7 managed detection and response.
- [Staff Augmentation](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/staff-augmentation): Embedded remote professionals across technical and operational roles, with US salary benchmark pricing table.
- [Offshore Staff Augmentation](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/offshore-staff-augmentation): Dedicated offshore developers and specialists from Pakistan on US-hours shifts.
- [Cybersecurity Staff Augmentation](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/cybersecurity-staff-augmentation): SOC analysts, security engineers, pen testers and GRC specialists added to your team.
- [Cloud Security Consulting](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/cloud-security-consulting): AWS, Azure and GCP security assessments against CIS Benchmarks, with remediation.
- [Accounting Staff Augmentation](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/accounting-staff-augmentation): Offshore accountants and bookkeepers trained on US GAAP for CPA firms and finance teams.
- [Finance & Accounting](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/finance-accounting): Bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, and reporting.
- [HR Services](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/hr-services): Recruiting, onboarding, payroll support, and HR operations.
- [Construction Estimating](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/construction-estimation): Remote takeoffs, pricing, and bid support for construction firms.
- [Web Development](https://www.mindwhiz.com/web-services): Websites, web apps, and dashboards.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.mindwhiz.com/services/digital-marketing): Brand, growth, and web execution.

## Frequently asked

- What services does MindWhiz provide? Managed IT and cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure, web development and digital marketing, and back-office support across finance, HR, and construction estimation, plus staff augmentation.
- Do you work with businesses of any size? Yes, from startups through established multi-site companies; pricing scales with headcount.
- Can MindWhiz extend an existing team instead of replacing it? Yes, this is the most common arrangement - MindWhiz staff work inside the client's own tools and processes.
- Which regions does MindWhiz cover? United States, United Kingdom, and Pakistan, with round-the-clock coverage across time zones.
- How do you cover US hours from Pakistan? US-facing staff work evening or night shifts in Lahore: 8 am-5 pm Eastern is 5 pm-2 am in Lahore; 8 am-5 pm Pacific is 8 pm-5 am. 24/7 services run on rotating shifts.
- Does MindWhiz have a US office? Yes: 2313 W Sam Houston Pkwy N #147, Houston, TX 77043. Most delivery staff work from Lahore on US-hours shifts.
